Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: combat shield (aquila)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A combat shield emblazoned with the Imperial aquila, the two-headed eagle that looks to the Imperium's past and future alike.

Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: combat shield (laurel)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A combat shield wreathed in laurels, a mark of honour granted for victories won in the Emperor's name.

Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: combat shield (winged skull)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A plain-faced combat shield crowned with a winged skull, a reminder that death in service is the highest duty.

Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: storm shield (sunburst)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A storm shield bearing a skull set against a radiant sunburst, after the light of the Astronomican that guides the Imperium's fleets.

Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: storm shield (crossbones)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A storm shield marked with a skull and crossed bones upon a pale cross, a grim promise to any foe who stands before it.

Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.label: storm shield (laurelled skull)
Core40k.AlternateBaseFormDef.description: A storm shield bearing a laurelled skull and an honour scroll, recording the deeds of those who carried it before.
